Per-arm AAD counts derived by percentage-corroboration from the stated percentages and arm denominators (each is the UNIQUE integer consistent with the printed percent): 5 of 41 = 12.195% (rounds to 12.2%; 4/41=9.8%, 6/41=14.6% do not) probiotic, 4 of 46 = 8.696% (rounds to 8.7%; 3/46=6.5%, 5/46=10.9% do not) placebo. Abstract path had declared it absent because the counts are given only as percentages, not as 'X of Y'.
24456384.verification: Percentage-derived arm counts 5/41 (12.2%) and 4/46 (8.7%) uniquely determined by the abstract percentages + denominators; count RR = (5/41)/(4/46) = 1.402 (probiotic slightly WORSE), so this addition moves the pool TOWARD the null, not toward benefit.
